reason: A client called me last month over a broken invoice total, and the README shows that exact bug being caught. It's free and it's one command, so I'll try it on one client app this week. Whether I keep it depends on how much work the recording turns out to be.
objection: Who maintains this next year? If the replays break on my clients' apps or the repo goes quiet, I'm left with a recording format nobody supports. The Playwright export helps, but only if those tests actually run without me fixing them by hand.
would_change_my_mind: If the first run on a real client app gives me a wall of false diffs or takes more than an hour to set up, I drop it.
